subject: general
question: _____ is a skill training program launched by Microsoft in collaboration with Ministry of Labour and Employment (MoLE) of India in September 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is "__**DigiSaksham**__". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• This **digital skills program** was started with the intention of promoting youth employability by enhancing their digital abilities, which have become crucial in today's increasingly technologically advanced world.
 
• **Microsoft India** and the **Ministry of Labor and Employment** collaborated on Digi Saksham.
 
• It is a continuation of the government's continuous initiatives to assist young people in rural and** semi-urban areas**.
 
• "**Aga Khan Rural Support Programme India (AKRSP-I)**" is the organization that will carry out the program on the ground.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​​More than **3 lakh youth **will receive free training in digital skills, including fundamentals and advanced computers, as part of the DigiSaksham program in the first year.
 
• The **National Career Service (NCS) Portal** is the place where you can access this training program.
 
• The campaign prioritizes hiring semi-urban job seekers from underserved communities who have lost their jobs due to the ongoing **COVID-19 pandemic**. 

c1:T
